text:
```yaml
name: Release Py

on:
  push:
    branches: [main]
    paths:
      - 'py/**'

jobs:
  release-py:
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
    permissions:
      id-token: write
      contents: read
    steps:
      - name: Checkout repository
        uses: actions/checkout@v4

      - name: Set up uv
        uses: pytorch/test-infra/.github/actions/setup-uv@main
        with:
          python-version: 3.12
          enable-cache: true

      - name: Release Python packages
        env:
          UV_PYPI_TOKEN: ${{ secrets.PYPI_TOKEN }}
          UV_WORKSPACE_EXCLUDE: py/common
        run: |
          bash -euo pipefail -c 'bash py/common/release.sh'
```
